notes.why_in_news: PM Modi offered continued support to Sri Lanka for cyclone relief, highlighting India's role in bilateral relations and humanitarian assistance.
notes.fact_box: PM Narendra Modi assured continued support to Sri Lanka under Operation Sagar Bandhu after Cyclone Ditwah. India has dispatched military assistance and rescue teams, and handed over 53 tonnes of relief material. The conversation took place on December 1, 2025.

prelims_pointers.text: Operation Sagar Bandhu is an ongoing humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) operation.
PM Narendra Modi conveyed support to Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake.
53 tonnes of relief material has been handed over to Sri Lanka.

notes.mains_question: Examine the role of India in providing humanitarian assistance to Sri Lanka during the cyclone Ditwah and the implications for bilateral relations.
